title: 雅思·段落衔接与论证 · 96 句
description: 用两个相连句子练习指代、举例、转折、因果、前提与结论；把单句表达扩展为完整论证关系。

items.zh: 免费早餐能让饥饿的学生更好地参与课堂。这种支持对很早出门、需要长途上学的孩子尤其有价值。
items.en: Free breakfasts can help hungry pupils participate in lessons. Such support is particularly valuable to children who leave home very early for a long journey to school.
answers: Free breakfasts can help hungry pupils participate in lessons. Such support is particularly valuable to children who leave home very early for a long journey to school.
items.notes: such support 回指免费早餐，并进一步说明受益对象。

items.zh: 考试提供了可比较的成绩。不过，它们只能反映有限时间内的表现。
items.en: Exams provide comparable scores. However, they capture performance within a limited period only.
answers: Exams provide comparable scores. However, they capture performance within a limited period only.
items.notes: however 引入评价范围的限制。

items.zh: 公园为居民提供免费的活动空间。例如，散步团体不必租用私人场地。
items.en: Parks provide residents with free space for activities. Walking groups, for example, need not hire private venues.
answers: Parks provide residents with free space for activities. Walking groups, for example, need not hire private venues.
Parks provide residents with free space for activities. Walking groups, for example, needn't hire private venues.
items.notes: for example 将一般观点落到具体活动。

items.zh: 低票价有助于提高公交吸引力。然而，乘客也需要相信车辆会按时到达。
items.en: Low fares can make buses more attractive. Passengers nevertheless need confidence that vehicles will arrive on time.
answers: Low fares can make buses more attractive. Passengers nevertheless need confidence that vehicles will arrive on time.
items.notes: nevertheless 承接优势后补充必要条件。

items.zh: 维修工具可以在社区共享。这样一来，偶尔使用的人就不必每人购买一套。
items.en: Repair tools can be shared within a community. Occasional users would therefore not need to buy a set each.
answers: Repair tools can be shared within a community. Occasional users would therefore not need to buy a set each.
items.notes: therefore 说明共享所带来的结果。

items.zh: 有些工人无法参加白天的培训。这并不一定说明他们缺乏学习意愿。
items.en: Some workers cannot attend daytime training. This does not necessarily indicate a lack of willingness to learn.
answers: Some workers cannot attend daytime training. This does not necessarily indicate a lack of willingness to learn.
Some workers can't attend daytime training. This doesn't necessarily indicate a lack of willingness to learn.
items.notes: this 回指无法参加，而非能力不足。

items.zh: 集中采购可能降低单位成本。相反，小批量采购可以让学校更灵活地调整材料。
items.en: Central purchasing may lower unit costs. Small orders, by contrast, can let schools adjust materials more flexibly.
answers: Central purchasing may lower unit costs. Small orders, by contrast, can let schools adjust materials more flexibly.
items.notes: by contrast 比较两种采购方式。

items.zh: 远程工作减少了通勤。此外，它可能扩大残障求职者可以申请的岗位范围。
items.en: Remote work reduces commuting. In addition, it may widen the range of jobs open to applicants with disabilities.
answers: Remote work reduces commuting. In addition, it may widen the range of jobs open to applicants with disabilities.
items.notes: in addition 补充另一个收益维度。

items.zh: 城镇吸引了更多游客。因此，季节性用工需求随之增加。
items.en: The town attracted more visitors. Demand for seasonal workers consequently increased.
answers: The town attracted more visitors. Demand for seasonal workers consequently increased.
items.notes: consequently 连接原因与后果。

items.zh: 家长可能把熟悉的教学方式当作更好的方式。换言之，偏好有时来自习惯，而不是对效果的比较。
items.en: Parents may regard familiar teaching methods as better. In other words, a preference can reflect habit rather than a comparison of effectiveness.
answers: Parents may regard familiar teaching methods as better. In other words, a preference can reflect habit rather than a comparison of effectiveness.
items.notes: in other words 用另一种说法解释前一句，而非另起新理由。

items.zh: 这项建议承认企业需要灵活性。与此同时，它要求员工能提前知道排班。
items.en: The proposal recognises businesses' need for flexibility. At the same time, it requires advance notice of staff schedules.
answers: The proposal recognises businesses' need for flexibility. At the same time, it requires advance notice of staff schedules.
items.notes: at the same time 表示并存的要求。

items.zh: 环保包装通常受到欢迎。即便如此，产品能否重复使用仍值得关注。
items.en: Environmentally friendly packaging is often welcomed. Even so, the product's reusability still deserves attention.
answers: Environmentally friendly packaging is often welcomed. Even so, the product's reusability still deserves attention.
items.notes: even so 表示即使承认前一点。

items.zh: 政策可以规定服务标准。但在实践中，执行还依赖足够的人手。
items.en: Policy can prescribe service standards. In practice, however, implementation also depends on adequate staffing.
answers: Policy can prescribe service standards. In practice, however, implementation also depends on adequate staffing.
items.notes: in practice 转向实际执行层面。

items.zh: 规则写得清楚并不足够。具体来说，居民还需要知道遇到问题时向谁求助。
items.en: Clear rules are not sufficient. More specifically, residents need to know whom to approach when problems arise.
answers: Clear rules are not sufficient. More specifically, residents need to know whom to approach when problems arise.
Clear rules aren't sufficient. More specifically, residents need to know whom to approach when problems arise.
items.notes: more specifically 细化所缺少的条件。

items.zh: 童年读书经历可能影响日后的阅读习惯。然而，成年人仍然可以培养新的兴趣。
items.en: Childhood reading experiences may influence later habits. Adults can still develop new interests, however.
answers: Childhood reading experiences may influence later habits. Adults can still develop new interests, however.
items.notes: 句末 however 同样表示转折。

items.zh: 单次捐赠可以解决紧急需要。长期服务则需要持续的资金来源。
items.en: A one-off donation can meet an urgent need. Long-term services, on the other hand, require continuing sources of funding.
answers: A one-off donation can meet an urgent need. Long-term services, on the other hand, require continuing sources of funding.
items.notes: on the other hand 区分不同时间尺度。

items.zh: 有人认为处罚越重越好。这种观点忽略了违法行为是否会被发现。
items.en: It is sometimes argued that harsher penalties are always better. This view overlooks whether offences are likely to be detected.
answers: It is sometimes argued that harsher penalties are always better. This view overlooks whether offences are likely to be detected.
items.notes: this view 明确回指待评价的观点。

items.zh: 保持老街特色很重要，但不必冻结所有变化。相反，适当改造可以使建筑继续有人使用。
items.en: An old street's character matters, but not every change must be prevented. Appropriate adaptation can instead keep buildings in use.
answers: An old street's character matters, but not every change must be prevented. Appropriate adaptation can instead keep buildings in use.
items.notes: instead 提出替代性保护路径。

items.zh: 可访问的在线服务节省时间。前提是使用者有合适的设备和技能。
items.en: Accessible online services save time. This assumes that users have suitable devices and skills.
answers: Accessible online services save time. This assumes that users have suitable devices and skills.
items.notes: this assumes that 揭示结论成立的前提。

items.zh: 提高工资可能吸引更多申请者。是否能留住员工，则还要看工作条件。
items.en: Higher wages may attract more applicants. Retention, however, also depends on working conditions.
answers: Higher wages may attract more applicants. Retention, however, also depends on working conditions.
items.notes: retention 接续招聘话题并区分留任问题。

items.zh: 一个城市可能拥有很多医院。不过，仅凭数量无法判断居民是否容易就医。
items.en: A city may have many hospitals. Numbers alone, however, cannot show how easily residents obtain care.
answers: A city may have many hospitals. Numbers alone, however, cannot show how easily residents obtain care.
A city may have many hospitals. Numbers alone, however, can't show how easily residents obtain care.
items.notes: numbers alone 回指医院数量。

items.zh: 过多车辆使街道拥挤，拥挤又降低公交速度。其结果是，公交对通勤者的吸引力可能进一步减弱。
items.en: Heavy traffic slows buses on crowded streets. As a result, public transport may become even less attractive to commuters.
answers: Heavy traffic slows buses on crowded streets. As a result, public transport may become even less attractive to commuters.
items.notes: as a result 延续同一作用链条。

items.zh: 年轻人需要获得工作经验，但无薪实习并非人人都能负担。因此，实习机会还涉及经济公平。
items.en: Young people need work experience, but unpaid placements are not affordable to everyone. Access to internships is therefore also an issue of economic fairness.
answers: Young people need work experience, but unpaid placements are not affordable to everyone. Access to internships is therefore also an issue of economic fairness.
Young people need work experience, but unpaid placements aren't affordable to everyone. Access to internships is therefore also an issue of economic fairness.
items.notes: therefore 从具体障碍推出公平维度。

items.zh: 收集更多数据可能提高服务效率。这同时提出了一个问题：这些信息究竟需要保留多久？
items.en: Collecting more data may improve service efficiency. It also raises a question: how long should the information be retained?
answers: Collecting more data may improve service efficiency. It also raises a question: how long should the information be retained?
items.notes: raises a question 引入需要继续讨论的问题。

items.zh: 图书馆可以提供安静的学习空间，社区中心则适合集体活动。两者服务于不同但互补的需要。
items.en: Libraries offer quiet study space, while community centres suit group activities. The two serve different but complementary needs.
answers: Libraries offer quiet study space, while community centres suit group activities. The two serve different but complementary needs.
items.notes: the two 回指两种设施。

items.zh: 有些患者需要面对面检查，另一些只需常规随访。由此可见，预约方式应根据需求选择。
items.en: Some patients need physical examinations; others require routine follow-up. The form of appointment should therefore reflect need.
answers: Some patients need physical examinations; others require routine follow-up. The form of appointment should therefore reflect need.
items.notes: others 与 some 对照两类需求。

items.zh: 禁止某种材料可能减少一种废弃物。但如果替代材料消耗更多资源，总体收益就不明确。
items.en: Banning a material may reduce one type of waste. If its replacement uses more resources, however, the overall benefit is unclear.
answers: Banning a material may reduce one type of waste. If its replacement uses more resources, however, the overall benefit is unclear.
items.notes: however 将评价扩展到整体结果。

items.zh: 解决住房短缺需要增加供应。这并不排除改善现有空置住房利用率的作用。
items.en: Addressing a housing shortage requires more supply. This does not rule out making better use of existing vacant homes.
answers: Addressing a housing shortage requires more supply. This does not rule out making better use of existing vacant homes.
Addressing a housing shortage requires more supply. This doesn't rule out making better use of existing vacant homes.
items.notes: rule out：排除另一种可行路径。

items.zh: 地方知识能帮助识别社区需求，专业知识则有助于评估技术方案。因此，两种知识都应参与规划。
items.en: Local knowledge helps identify community needs, whereas expertise supports technical assessment. Both should therefore inform planning.
answers: Local knowledge helps identify community needs, whereas expertise supports technical assessment. Both should therefore inform planning.
items.notes: both 回指两种知识来源。

items.zh: 短期成果可以证明项目开始起效，但不能说明效果会持续。判断长期价值仍需要后续观察。
items.en: Early results can show that a project is beginning to work, but not that its effects will last. Follow-up remains necessary to judge long-term value.
answers: Early results can show that a project is beginning to work, but not that its effects will last. Follow-up remains necessary to judge long-term value.
items.notes: but not that 并列两个不同结论。

items.zh: 讨论不应停留在是否使用新技术。更有用的问题是，它在哪些任务中能带来可验证的改进。
items.en: The debate should go beyond whether to use new technology. A more useful question is which tasks show verifiable improvement.
answers: The debate should go beyond whether to use new technology. A more useful question is which tasks show verifiable improvement.
items.notes: go beyond：超越原有讨论范围。

items.zh: 维修人员不足和零件延误都会中断公交服务。因此，改善可靠性需要同时解决用工和供应问题。
items.en: Staff shortages and delayed spare parts can both disrupt bus services. Improving reliability therefore requires action on staffing and supplies together.
answers: Staff shortages and delayed spare parts can both disrupt bus services. Improving reliability therefore requires action on staffing and supplies together.
items.notes: therefore 将前句的两类原因汇总成配套建议。

items.zh: 路灯能够帮助行人看清路面障碍。因此，在容易绊倒的路段改善照明可能减少跌倒。
items.en: Street lights help pedestrians spot obstacles on the pavement. Better lighting may therefore reduce falls on stretches where tripping is common.
answers: Street lights help pedestrians spot obstacles on the pavement. Better lighting may therefore reduce falls on stretches where tripping is common.
items.notes: therefore 的推论由看清障碍这一机制支撑。

items.zh: 临时工往往不知道下个月能工作多少小时。这种不确定性使安排固定支出变得困难。
items.en: Temporary workers often do not know how many hours they will work next month. This uncertainty makes regular expenses difficult to plan for.
answers: Temporary workers often do not know how many hours they will work next month. This uncertainty makes regular expenses difficult to plan for.
Temporary workers often don't know how many hours they will work next month. This uncertainty makes regular expenses difficult to plan for.
items.notes: this uncertainty 将上一句概括为名词并承接结果。

items.zh: 维修手册说明零件如何拆卸。有了这些信息，独立维修店便能处理更多型号。
items.en: Repair manuals explain how components can be removed. With this information, independent workshops can service a wider range of models.
answers: Repair manuals explain how components can be removed. With this information, independent workshops can service a wider range of models.
items.notes: with this information 明确后句依赖的资源。

items.zh: 噪声可能打断居民的睡眠。睡眠反复中断又可能影响他们白天的注意力。
items.en: Noise can interrupt residents' sleep. Repeated interruptions may in turn affect their concentration during the day.
answers: Noise can interrupt residents' sleep. Repeated interruptions may in turn affect their concentration during the day.
items.notes: in turn 延续两步作用链，不突然跳到无关结果。

items.zh: 果蔬容易在长途运输中损坏。因此，缩短供应路线可能减少到店之前的损耗。
items.en: Fruit and vegetables are vulnerable to damage during long journeys. Shorter supply routes may consequently reduce losses before produce reaches shops.
answers: Fruit and vegetables are vulnerable to damage during long journeys. Shorter supply routes may consequently reduce losses before produce reaches shops.
items.notes: consequently 引出运输距离与损耗之间的推论。

items.zh: 网页要求填写过多不必要的信息。有些用户因此在提交之前就放弃了申请。
items.en: The website asks for too much unnecessary information. Some users abandon their applications before submission as a result.
answers: The website asks for too much unnecessary information. Some users abandon their applications before submission as a result.
items.notes: as a result 放在句末，回指信息负担。

items.zh: 老师逐个批改草稿需要时间。当班级规模扩大时，这种反馈便更难及时提供。
items.en: Commenting on individual drafts takes teachers time. As classes grow, such feedback becomes harder to provide promptly.
answers: Commenting on individual drafts takes teachers time. As classes grow, such feedback becomes harder to provide promptly.
items.notes: such feedback 回指逐个批改，而非泛指全部教学。

items.zh: 当地商店允许顾客少量购买。这有助于储存空间有限的家庭避免囤积食物。
items.en: Local shops let customers buy small quantities. This helps households with limited storage avoid accumulating food.
answers: Local shops let customers buy small quantities. This helps households with limited storage avoid accumulating food.
items.notes: this 回指少量购买的便利，并具体说明受益条件。

items.zh: 某些公共信息需要多种呈现方式。例如，疏散通知可以同时使用声音、文字和图示。
items.en: Some public information requires several forms of presentation. Evacuation notices, for instance, can combine sound, text and diagrams.
answers: Some public information requires several forms of presentation. Evacuation notices, for instance, can combine sound, text and diagrams.
items.notes: for instance 引入同一类别中的具体案例。

items.zh: 实践课程能暴露书面计划没有体现的问题。制作模型时才发现零件无法连接，就是一个例子。
items.en: Practical lessons can reveal problems absent from written plans. Discovering that parts do not fit while building a model is one example.
answers: Practical lessons can reveal problems absent from written plans. Discovering that parts do not fit while building a model is one example.
Practical lessons can reveal problems absent from written plans. Discovering that parts don't fit while building a model is one example.
items.notes: one example 的内容具体对应计划与实践的差异。

items.zh: 在线档案可以让远处的读者接触稀有材料。一名乡村学生便可能借此查阅原本需要长途旅行才能看到的手稿。
items.en: Online archives can bring rare material to distant readers. A rural student might thus consult a manuscript that would otherwise require a long journey.
answers: Online archives can bring rare material to distant readers. A rural student might thus consult a manuscript that would otherwise require a long journey.
items.notes: otherwise 表示没有在线档案这一条件时的情况。

items.zh: 灵活排班可以满足不同人生阶段的需要。就新手父母而言，较晚开始上班可能更容易配合托儿安排。
items.en: Flexible scheduling can accommodate different life stages. For new parents, a later start may fit childcare arrangements more easily.
answers: Flexible scheduling can accommodate different life stages. For new parents, a later start may fit childcare arrangements more easily.
items.notes: for new parents 将泛论缩小到特定人群。

items.zh: 并非所有节能措施都涉及购买新设备。封堵现有窗户周围的缝隙也能减少热量流失。
items.en: Not every energy-saving measure involves buying new equipment. Sealing gaps around existing windows can also reduce heat loss.
answers: Not every energy-saving measure involves buying new equipment. Sealing gaps around existing windows can also reduce heat loss.
items.notes: 第二句直接提供反例；not every 为部分否定。

items.zh: 有些职业技能很难通过笔试判断。厨师在繁忙时段协调多道菜的能力便是其中之一。
items.en: Some professional skills are difficult to assess through written tests. A chef's ability to coordinate several dishes during a busy service is one such skill.
answers: Some professional skills are difficult to assess through written tests. A chef's ability to coordinate several dishes during a busy service is one such skill.
items.notes: one such skill 明确回指待评估的能力。

items.zh: 共享空间需要兼顾不同的使用方式。具体来说，安静阅读区不宜紧挨着排练室。
items.en: Shared spaces need to accommodate different uses. In concrete terms, a quiet reading area should not sit immediately beside a rehearsal room.
answers: Shared spaces need to accommodate different uses. In concrete terms, a quiet reading area should not sit immediately beside a rehearsal room.
Shared spaces need to accommodate different uses. In concrete terms, a quiet reading area shouldn't sit immediately beside a rehearsal room.
items.notes: in concrete terms 将设计原则转化为布局实例。

items.zh: 交通障碍不仅包括距离。对于轮椅使用者，没有升降设施的台阶也可能阻断路线。
items.en: Transport barriers involve more than distance. For a wheelchair user, steps without a lift may also make a route impassable.
answers: Transport barriers involve more than distance. For a wheelchair user, steps without a lift may also make a route impassable.
items.notes: also 补充另一类障碍，而非重复距离因素。

items.zh: 统一制服可能减轻穿着攀比。即便如此，学校仍需考虑低收入家庭的购买费用。
items.en: A common uniform may reduce competition over clothing. Even so, schools need to consider the purchase cost for low-income families.
answers: A common uniform may reduce competition over clothing. Even so, schools need to consider the purchase cost for low-income families.
items.notes: even so 承认第一项收益后保留成本问题。

items.zh: 大型仓储设施能集中处理货物。不过，周边道路可能因此承受更多卡车流量。
items.en: Large warehouses can consolidate goods handling. The surrounding roads may nevertheless face additional lorry traffic.
answers: Large warehouses can consolidate goods handling. The surrounding roads may nevertheless face additional lorry traffic.
items.notes: nevertheless 从物流收益转到当地交通代价。

items.zh: 公开会议让居民直接表达意见。然而，不能到场的人也需要其他参与途径。
items.en: Open meetings let residents express their views directly. Those unable to attend, however, need other ways to participate.
answers: Open meetings let residents express their views directly. Those unable to attend, however, need other ways to participate.
items.notes: those unable to attend 限定未被第一种渠道覆盖的人。

items.zh: 快速招聘可以填补紧急空缺。速度本身却不能保证候选人适合长期工作。
items.en: Rapid recruitment can fill urgent vacancies. Speed alone, though, does not guarantee a suitable long-term appointment.
answers: Rapid recruitment can fill urgent vacancies. Speed alone, though, does not guarantee a suitable long-term appointment.
Rapid recruitment can fill urgent vacancies. Speed alone, though, doesn't guarantee a suitable long-term appointment.
items.notes: though 插入句中表示让步后的限制。

items.zh: 数字地图提供便捷的导航。但当信号中断时，熟悉实体路标仍有价值。
items.en: Digital maps provide convenient navigation. Familiarity with physical landmarks remains valuable when the signal fails, however.
answers: Digital maps provide convenient navigation. Familiarity with physical landmarks remains valuable when the signal fails, however.
items.notes: 后句提供便利性无法覆盖的具体情形。

items.zh: 延长营业时间让顾客更方便。这种便利也必须与员工的休息需要相平衡。
items.en: Longer opening hours make shopping more convenient. That convenience must also be balanced against employees' need for rest.
answers: Longer opening hours make shopping more convenient. That convenience must also be balanced against employees' need for rest.
items.notes: that convenience 接续前句收益；balance against 权衡。

items.zh: 比赛能激发部分学生的练习热情。其他学生却可能因为害怕排名而减少参与。
items.en: Competitions can motivate some pupils to practise. Others may withdraw from participation for fear of being ranked.
answers: Competitions can motivate some pupils to practise. Others may withdraw from participation for fear of being ranked.
items.notes: some 与 others 对照两种不同反应。

items.zh: 新建筑通常更容易配备现代设施。不过，拆除旧楼所产生的废料也应纳入评估。
items.en: New buildings are generally easier to equip with modern facilities. Waste from demolishing existing structures should nonetheless enter the assessment.
answers: New buildings are generally easier to equip with modern facilities. Waste from demolishing existing structures should nonetheless enter the assessment.
items.notes: nonetheless 将评价范围扩展到拆除阶段。

items.zh: 分散办公可以扩大招聘范围。这个优势成立的前提是团队能够跨地点有效协作。
items.en: Distributed offices can widen recruitment. This advantage depends on teams collaborating effectively across locations.
answers: Distributed offices can widen recruitment. This advantage depends on teams collaborating effectively across locations.
items.notes: this advantage 回指招聘范围扩大，并说明必要条件。

items.zh: 税收优惠可能鼓励企业投资。但如果企业本来就计划投资，额外效果可能很小。
items.en: Tax relief may encourage business investment. Where firms already intended to invest, however, the additional effect may be small.
answers: Tax relief may encourage business investment. Where firms already intended to invest, however, the additional effect may be small.
items.notes: where 表示在某种情形下，限定政策的新增效果。

items.zh: 博物馆的免费时段可能吸引新观众。这一判断不一定适用于交通费用仍然很高的人。
items.en: Free museum sessions may attract new audiences. This claim may not hold for people who still face high travel costs.
answers: Free museum sessions may attract new audiences. This claim may not hold for people who still face high travel costs.
items.notes: hold for：适用于；限定观点适用的人群。

items.zh: 集中供餐可以降低准备成本。只有食品能及时送达，这种节约才有实际意义。
items.en: Centralised meal preparation can lower preparation costs. Such savings matter in practice only if food arrives on time.
answers: Centralised meal preparation can lower preparation costs. Such savings matter in practice only if food arrives on time.
items.notes: only if 引出必要条件，不能与 if only 混淆。

items.zh: 重复练习有助于巩固技能。这并不意味着练习错误方法也有同样的好处。
items.en: Repeated practice helps consolidate skills. It does not follow that rehearsing an incorrect method offers the same benefit.
answers: Repeated practice helps consolidate skills. It does not follow that rehearsing an incorrect method offers the same benefit.
Repeated practice helps consolidate skills. It doesn't follow that rehearsing an incorrect method offers the same benefit.
items.notes: it does not follow that 阻止从前句过度推论。

items.zh: 小型试点能够揭示操作问题。但它未必能反映全国推广时所需的资源。
items.en: A small pilot can reveal operational problems. It may not capture the resources required for a national rollout.
answers: A small pilot can reveal operational problems. It may not capture the resources required for a national rollout.
items.notes: may not capture 限定试点证据的覆盖范围。

items.zh: 社区花园能提供接触自然的机会。对于土地受到污染的地块，则必须先评估种植是否安全。
items.en: Community gardens offer contact with nature. On contaminated sites, the safety of growing plants must first be assessed.
answers: Community gardens offer contact with nature. On contaminated sites, the safety of growing plants must first be assessed.
items.notes: on contaminated sites 引入需要额外条件的特定情形。

items.zh: 统一申请表可以简化流程。前提是问题本身适合不同类型的申请人。
items.en: A common application form can simplify a procedure. That assumes its questions suit different types of applicant.
answers: A common application form can simplify a procedure. That assumes its questions suit different types of applicant.
items.notes: that assumes 揭示格式统一能奏效的前提。

items.zh: 课堂讲解能迅速传递基本概念。独立项目则让学生检验自己能否应用这些概念。
items.en: Classroom explanations can convey basic concepts quickly. Independent projects, by comparison, let students test whether they can apply them.
answers: Classroom explanations can convey basic concepts quickly. Independent projects, by comparison, let students test whether they can apply them.
items.notes: by comparison 对照两种教学活动的不同功能。

items.zh: 大型企业可能拥有专门的培训团队。较小的企业通常需要从外部购买这类支持。
items.en: Large employers may have dedicated training teams. Smaller firms often need to purchase this support externally.
answers: Large employers may have dedicated training teams. Smaller firms often need to purchase this support externally.
items.notes: this support 回指培训服务，保持比较维度一致。

items.zh: 紧急救助关注眼前的缺口。预防措施则试图减少同类危机再次发生的可能性。
items.en: Emergency assistance addresses immediate gaps. Prevention instead seeks to reduce the likelihood of similar crises recurring.
answers: Emergency assistance addresses immediate gaps. Prevention instead seeks to reduce the likelihood of similar crises recurring.
items.notes: instead 对比即时响应与降低复发风险的目标。

items.zh: 修缮屋顶会产生一次性支出。推迟修缮却可能带来反复漏水的费用。
items.en: Repairing a roof involves a one-off expense. Deferral, by contrast, may lead to recurring costs from leaks.
answers: Repairing a roof involves a one-off expense. Deferral, by contrast, may lead to recurring costs from leaks.
items.notes: deferral 名词化承接推迟修缮；one-off 与 recurring 对照。

items.zh: 个人通勤费用可能因搬家而下降。从城市整体来看，交通负担却未必会相应减轻。
items.en: Moving home may lower an individual's commuting costs. At city level, the overall transport burden may not fall accordingly.
answers: Moving home may lower an individual's commuting costs. At city level, the overall transport burden may not fall accordingly.
items.notes: at city level 将个人尺度与整体尺度区分。

items.zh: 预约制度能减少现场排队。另一方面，随到随办更适合无法提前确定日程的人。
items.en: Appointment systems can reduce queues on site. Walk-in access, on the other hand, better suits people unable to plan their schedules in advance.
answers: Appointment systems can reduce queues on site. Walk-in access, on the other hand, better suits people unable to plan their schedules in advance.
items.notes: on the other hand 对照两种服务方式的适用对象。

items.zh: 一项补贴可能在推出后立即带动销量。它能否改变长期使用习惯，需要另行评估。
items.en: A subsidy may boost sales immediately after introduction. Its capacity to change long-term usage habits requires a separate assessment.
answers: A subsidy may boost sales immediately after introduction. Its capacity to change long-term usage habits requires a separate assessment.
items.notes: sales 与 usage habits 是不同结果，不能相互替代。

items.zh: 自动化工具擅长重复一致的步骤。判断模糊的例外情况则可能仍需人工介入。
items.en: Automated tools handle consistent, repetitive steps well. Ambiguous exceptions may still require human judgement.
answers: Automated tools handle consistent, repetitive steps well. Ambiguous exceptions may still require human judgement.
items.notes: exceptions 与 repetitive steps 对照任务性质。

items.zh: 负责任的消费不仅是购买带有环保标签的产品。它还涉及决定是否确实需要购买。
items.en: Responsible consumption extends beyond choosing products with environmental labels. It also involves deciding whether a purchase is necessary at all.
answers: Responsible consumption extends beyond choosing products with environmental labels. It also involves deciding whether a purchase is necessary at all.
items.notes: extends beyond 后再用 also 扩展概念范围。

items.zh: 一所学校的开放程度不能只看招生简章。实际问题是，不同背景的学生能否完成申请并获得支持。
items.en: A school's openness cannot be judged solely from its prospectus. The practical issue is whether students from different backgrounds can apply and obtain support.
answers: A school's openness cannot be judged solely from its prospectus. The practical issue is whether students from different backgrounds can apply and obtain support.
A school's openness can't be judged solely from its prospectus. The practical issue is whether students from different backgrounds can apply and obtain support.
items.notes: the practical issue is 将抽象评价转化为可检查的问题。

items.zh: 可信的道歉需要承认具体造成了什么伤害。换句话说，仅仅表达遗憾可能还不够。
items.en: A credible apology needs to acknowledge the specific harm caused. In other words, expressing regret alone may be insufficient.
answers: A credible apology needs to acknowledge the specific harm caused. In other words, expressing regret alone may be insufficient.
items.notes: in other words 重述同一要求的另一面。

items.zh: 提高生产率并不总意味着工作更久。它也可以意味着用相同时间完成更多有用的工作。
items.en: Higher productivity does not always mean working longer. It can also mean completing more useful work in the same amount of time.
answers: Higher productivity does not always mean working longer. It can also mean completing more useful work in the same amount of time.
Higher productivity doesn't always mean working longer. It can also mean completing more useful work in the same amount of time.
items.notes: it 指提高生产率；用相同时间明确效率概念。

items.zh: 信息透明要求公众能够理解披露的内容。因此，文件公开与信息真正可用之间仍有区别。
items.en: Transparency requires people to understand what is disclosed. Publishing documents and making information usable are therefore still distinct.
answers: Transparency requires people to understand what is disclosed. Publishing documents and making information usable are therefore still distinct.
items.notes: therefore 从理解要求引出公开与可用的概念区分。

items.zh: 安静的课堂未必是投入的课堂。沉默可能来自专注，也可能来自害怕提问。
items.en: A quiet classroom is not necessarily an engaged one. Silence may reflect concentration, but it may also reflect fear of asking questions.
answers: A quiet classroom is not necessarily an engaged one. Silence may reflect concentration, but it may also reflect fear of asking questions.
A quiet classroom isn't necessarily an engaged one. Silence may reflect concentration, but it may also reflect fear of asking questions.
items.notes: 第二句为同一观察提供两种可能解释。

items.zh: 适应老龄化不应只被理解为增建养老院。它还包括让普通住宅更适合行动不便的人。
items.en: Adapting to an ageing population should not be understood solely as building more care homes. It also includes making ordinary housing suitable for people with limited mobility.
answers: Adapting to an ageing population should not be understood solely as building more care homes. It also includes making ordinary housing suitable for people with limited mobility.
Adapting to an ageing population shouldn't be understood solely as building more care homes. It also includes making ordinary housing suitable for people with limited mobility.
items.notes: solely 限定过窄的定义，后句补充另一层面。

items.zh: 服务的可负担性取决于使用者的收入。也就是说，同样的收费可能对不同家庭形成截然不同的负担。
items.en: Service affordability depends on users' incomes. That is, the same fee may impose very different burdens on different households.
answers: Service affordability depends on users' incomes. That is, the same fee may impose very different burdens on different households.
items.notes: that is 解释前句含义，不引入无关论点。

items.zh: 批评者把低参与率归因于冷漠。然而，活动安排在工作时间也可能解释这一现象。
items.en: Critics attribute low participation to apathy. Scheduling activities during working hours offers another possible explanation, however.
answers: Critics attribute low participation to apathy. Scheduling activities during working hours offers another possible explanation, however.
items.notes: attribute ... to：归因于；possible explanation 保留不确定性。

items.zh: 有人把平台用户增长视为满意度提高的证据。但用户也可能只是缺乏可行的替代选择。
items.en: Some see growth in platform users as evidence of greater satisfaction. Users may simply lack viable alternatives, though.
answers: Some see growth in platform users as evidence of greater satisfaction. Users may simply lack viable alternatives, though.
items.notes: though 提供与原推论竞争的解释。

items.zh: 高分学生可能更常参加课外班。这种联系本身不能证明课外班造成了高分。
items.en: High-scoring pupils may attend extra classes more often. The association alone does not establish that the classes caused their high scores.
answers: High-scoring pupils may attend extra classes more often. The association alone does not establish that the classes caused their high scores.
High-scoring pupils may attend extra classes more often. The association alone doesn't establish that the classes caused their high scores.
items.notes: association 与 caused 区分相关和因果。

items.zh: 反对者认为限制停车会损害所有商家。但依赖步行客流的店铺未必受到同样影响。
items.en: Opponents argue that parking restrictions harm all businesses. Shops dependent on pedestrian traffic may not be affected in the same way.
answers: Opponents argue that parking restrictions harm all businesses. Shops dependent on pedestrian traffic may not be affected in the same way.
items.notes: 后句质疑 all 的概括范围，而非否认全部影响。

items.zh: 设备更新之后投诉减少了。不过，同一时期客服人数也增加了。
items.en: Complaints fell after the equipment was upgraded. Customer service staffing also increased over the same period, however.
answers: Complaints fell after the equipment was upgraded. Customer service staffing also increased over the same period, however.
items.notes: over the same period 提出同时变化的另一因素。

items.zh: 小班学生表现更好，可能与教学有关。但学生原有水平也需要纳入比较。
items.en: Better performance in small classes may reflect teaching. Pupils' prior attainment also needs to enter the comparison.
answers: Better performance in small classes may reflect teaching. Pupils' prior attainment also needs to enter the comparison.
items.notes: prior attainment 提醒比较需考虑基线差异。

items.zh: 某些建议把传统做法视为毫无价值。这种判断忽略了其中可能包含的当地适应经验。
items.en: Some proposals treat traditional practices as worthless. Such a judgement overlooks the local adaptations they may embody.
answers: Some proposals treat traditional practices as worthless. Such a judgement overlooks the local adaptations they may embody.
items.notes: such a judgement 回指价值判断；may 避免反向绝对化。

items.zh: 一种方法在一次紧急事件中有效，并不能证明它应成为日常规则。常态使用还需要考虑累积成本。
items.en: A method's success in one emergency does not establish that it should become routine. Regular use also requires consideration of cumulative costs.
answers: A method's success in one emergency does not establish that it should become routine. Regular use also requires consideration of cumulative costs.
A method's success in one emergency doesn't establish that it should become routine. Regular use also requires consideration of cumulative costs.
items.notes: routine 与 one emergency 区分非常情况和常态。

items.zh: 学生需要明确的标准，也需要试错空间。因此，评分细则应与低风险练习相结合。
items.en: Students need clear standards as well as room to experiment. Assessment criteria should therefore be paired with low-stakes practice.
answers: Students need clear standards as well as room to experiment. Assessment criteria should therefore be paired with low-stakes practice.
items.notes: therefore 的建议同时回应前句两项需要。

items.zh: 社区了解本地积水点，工程师能够分析排水能力。结合这两类信息可以改善防洪规划。
items.en: Communities know where water collects locally, and engineers can assess drainage capacity. Combining these sources of information can improve flood planning.
answers: Communities know where water collects locally, and engineers can assess drainage capacity. Combining these sources of information can improve flood planning.
items.notes: these sources of information 共同回指两类知识。

items.zh: 广告能提供产品信息，也可能淡化限制条件。消费者教育因而需要同时训练比较和质疑的能力。
items.en: Advertising can inform people about products while downplaying limitations. Consumer education should consequently develop both comparison skills and critical questioning.
answers: Advertising can inform people about products while downplaying limitations. Consumer education should consequently develop both comparison skills and critical questioning.
items.notes: both ... and ... 对应信息获取和识别局限两项任务。

items.zh: 有些空置店面位置便利，但租约缺乏灵活性。因此，临时社区使用可能需要新的租赁安排。
items.en: Some vacant shops are well located but lack flexible leases. Temporary community use may therefore require new rental arrangements.
answers: Some vacant shops are well located but lack flexible leases. Temporary community use may therefore require new rental arrangements.
items.notes: 后句针对租约障碍提出具体条件。

items.zh: 家庭照护者提供重要支持，却经常缺少休息时间。喘息服务可以回应这一具体缺口。
items.en: Family carers provide vital support but often lack time off. Respite services can address this specific gap.
answers: Family carers provide vital support but often lack time off. Respite services can address this specific gap.
items.notes: this specific gap 回指休息不足；respite services：喘息服务。

items.zh: 评估既要考察平均结果，也要识别哪些人被落下。因此，按群体报告结果应成为常规。
items.en: Evaluation needs to examine average outcomes and identify who is being left behind. Reporting results by group should accordingly become routine.
answers: Evaluation needs to examine average outcomes and identify who is being left behind. Reporting results by group should accordingly become routine.
items.notes: accordingly 引出与两项评估目标一致的做法。

items.zh: 城市需要绿地，也需要可负担的住房。规划的任务是协调这两种需求，而不是假定其中一种可以忽略。
items.en: Cities need green space as well as affordable housing. Planning must reconcile these needs rather than assume that either can be ignored.
answers: Cities need green space as well as affordable housing. Planning must reconcile these needs rather than assume that either can be ignored.
items.notes: these needs 回指两项需求；reconcile：协调。

items.zh: 每种政策选择都有实施成本和不确定性。因此，负责任的建议应说明取舍及其依据。
items.en: Every policy option carries implementation costs and uncertainty. Responsible recommendations should therefore explain trade-offs and the reasoning behind them.
answers: Every policy option carries implementation costs and uncertainty. Responsible recommendations should therefore explain trade-offs and the reasoning behind them.
items.notes: the reasoning behind them 要求结论交代取舍依据。
